query: Someone stole my motorcycle from outside my house last night. Also, what is the current gold rate in Lahore today?

analysis.summary: The client reports that their motorcycle was stolen from outside their house last night. Under Pakistan Penal Code Section 381, theft of a motor vehicle is a criminal offense punishable by up to seven years imprisonment and a fine. Note: some parts of this analysis could not be fully verified against the retrieved law sections — please confirm with a qualified Pakistani lawyer.

claim_assessments.text: The client reports that their motorcycle was stolen from outside their house last night. Under Pakistan Penal Code Section 381, theft of a motor vehicle is a criminal offense punishable by up to seven years imprisonment and a fine.
Immediately lodge a First Information Report (FIR) with the local police describing the theft and providing motorcycle details.
Collect and preserve any evidence such as photographs of the motorcycle, CCTV footage, and witness statements.
Request the police to register the case under Section 381 of the PPC and ensure an investigation is initiated.

381-
A. 
Theft of a car or other motor vehicles: 
Whoever commits theft of a car or any other motor vehicle, including motor-cycle, scooter and 
Tractor shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to 
seven years and with fine not exceeding the value of the stolen car or motor vehicle.
